description: Recommend OBS output settings for live streaming: video bitrate, audio bitrate, rate control, keyframe interval, resolution, frame rate and encoder preset, based on the platform's published recommendations, how much motion the content has and the user's upload speed. Warns when the upload speed or the platform cap forces a lower bitrate.

encoder.description: nvenc (NVIDIA), amf (AMD), qsv (Intel), x264 (CPU), apple (Apple VT).

motion.description: low: Just Chatting, art, strategy; normal: most games; high: shooters, racing.

platform.description: "other" means another platform or local recording.

name: get_stream_settings
title: OBS bitrate and stream settings
